comment: Default MIDI mapping between the controller firmware and the bridge. Channel numbers are 1-16. Platter and knobs send relative CC (two's complement, 7 bit: 1..63 is +1..+63, 127..65 is -1..-63). Faders send absolute CC 0..127. Keys send note on (velocity > 0) and note off. Lights go the other way as SysEx.
